package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

func (store Store) GetByTaskInstance(ctx context.Context, taskInstanceID string) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, error) {
	return scanPracticeLearningRoute(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT idempotency_key::text, request_hash, route_json
FROM practice_learning_route_resolution
WHERE task_instance_id=$1`, taskInstanceID))
}

func (store Store) GetByID(ctx context.Context, routeID string) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, error) {
	return scanPracticeLearningRoute(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT idempotency_key::text, request_hash, route_json
FROM practice_learning_route_resolution
WHERE id=$1`, routeID))
}

func (store Store) Ensure(ctx context.Context, record domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, bool, error) {
	routeJSON, err := json.Marshal(record.Route)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, false, err
	}
	tx, err := store.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, false, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1, 0))`, "practice-route:"+record.Route.TaskInstanceID); err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, false, err
	}
	existing, err := scanPracticeLearningRoute(tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT idempotency_key::text, request_hash, route_json
FROM practice_learning_route_resolution
WHERE task_instance_id=$1`, record.Route.TaskInstanceID))
	if err == nil {
		if existing.RequestHash != record.RequestHash || existing.IdempotencyKey != record.IdempotencyKey {
			return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, false, err
		}
		return existing, false, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, false, err
	}
	_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO practice_learning_route_resolution(
    id, task_instance_id, task_revision_id, student_id, idempotency_key,
    request_hash, route_digest, route_json, created_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)`,
		record.Route.ID, record.Route.TaskInstanceID, record.Route.TaskRevisionID, record.Route.StudentID,
		record.IdempotencyKey, record.RequestHash, record.Route.RouteDigest, routeJSON, record.Route.CreatedAt,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, false, err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, false, err
	}
	return record, true, nil
}

func (store Store) GetByIdempotencyKey(ctx context.Context, taskInstanceID, stepID, idempotencyKey string) (domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord, error) {
	return scanPracticeLearningReadiness(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT idempotency_key::text, request_hash, receipt_json
FROM practice_learning_readiness_receipt
WHERE task_instance_id=$1 AND step_id=$2 AND idempotency_key=$3`, taskInstanceID, stepID, idempotencyKey))
}

func (store Store) EnsureReadiness(ctx context.Context, record domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord) (domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord, bool, error) {
	if !domain.ValidPracticeLearningReadinessReceipt(record.Receipt) || record.RequestHash == "" || record.IdempotencyKey == "" {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	receiptJSON, err := json.Marshal(record.Receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, err
	}
	tx, err := store.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	lockKey := "practice-readiness:" + record.Receipt.TaskInstanceID + ":" + record.Receipt.StepID + ":" + record.IdempotencyKey
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1, 0))`, lockKey); err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, err
	}
	existing, err := scanPracticeLearningReadiness(tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT idempotency_key::text, request_hash, receipt_json
FROM practice_learning_readiness_receipt
WHERE task_instance_id=$1 AND step_id=$2 AND idempotency_key=$3`,
		record.Receipt.TaskInstanceID, record.Receipt.StepID, record.IdempotencyKey))
	if err == nil {
		if existing.RequestHash != record.RequestHash || existing.IdempotencyKey != record.IdempotencyKey {
			return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, err
		}
		return existing, false, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, err
	}
	_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO practice_learning_readiness_receipt(
    id, task_instance_id, student_id, task_revision_id, route_id, step_id,
    idempotency_key, request_hash, receipt_json, created_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9::jsonb,$10)`,
		record.Receipt.ID, record.Receipt.TaskInstanceID, record.Receipt.StudentID, record.Receipt.TaskRevisionID,
		record.Receipt.RouteID, record.Receipt.StepID, record.IdempotencyKey, record.RequestHash, receiptJSON, record.Receipt.ObservedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, err
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, false, err
	}
	return record, true, nil
}

type practiceRouteRow interface{ Scan(...any) error }

func scanPracticeLearningRoute(row practiceRouteRow) (domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord, error) {
	var record domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord
	var routeJSON []byte
	if err := row.Scan(&record.IdempotencyKey, &record.RequestHash, &routeJSON); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
			return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, err
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(routeJSON, &record.Route); err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeLearningRouteRecord{}, err
	}
	return record, nil
}

func scanPracticeLearningReadiness(row practiceRouteRow) (domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord, error) {
	var record domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord
	var receiptJSON []byte
	if err := row.Scan(&record.IdempotencyKey, &record.RequestHash, &receiptJSON); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
			return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, err
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(receiptJSON, &record.Receipt); err != nil || !domain.ValidPracticeLearningReadinessReceipt(record.Receipt) {
		return domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRecord{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return record, nil
}

var _ repository.PracticeLearningRouteRepository = Store{}
var _ repository.PracticeLearningReadinessRepository = Store{}
